name: variants_atlas
description: Every attested reading of every kural, classified against the canonical text, with its witnesses and the ruling that decided it. Readings carried only under CC-BY-SA are in variants_atlas_sa.

fields.name: reading_id
fields.description: Id of this reading, <kural_id>#r<n>; r0 is the canonical text.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The reading exactly as its witnesses carry it, after cleaning rules that never change a letter.

fields.name: status
fields.description: canonical, formatting variant, encoding variant, metrical form, alternate reading, rejected reading (ledger ruling or print comparison), or corrupt.

fields.name: same_letters_as_canonical
fields.description: True when the reading has the canonical letters and differs only in spacing, punctuation, markup or encoding.

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.description: The ruling that decided between this reading and the canonical one, if any.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Every witness that carries this reading, with file, row and column.
